decision.summary: No new action: the weekly 74k dip and the daily 77k reach remain the two live frontier positions, and no cleaner additional edge is available right now.
decision.rationale: The current book is already expressing both sides of the near-term map well: the weekly 74k dip covers Beecthor's structural bearish thesis, while the daily 77k reach captures the corrective rebound path he also allowed. Binance is still neutral intraday, so there is no fresh confirmation strong enough to justify adding a second daily in either direction. The existing 77k reach cannot be re-added because it is already at the full early-stage $1 live cash cap, and the weekly 74k dip is also already at cap. Neither open position is near take-profit or exceptional invalidation. The next daily dip at 75k is only about 28.5% and not clean enough to open alongside a still-valid 77k corrective rebound, while 78k reach and 72k weekly dip are too far/too weak. Best move is to hold and wait.
